sentences.en: Last month my sister gave birth to a six-pound baby.
sentences.zh: 上个月我姐姐生了一个六磅重的宝宝。

sentences.en: Flesh gives birth to flesh, Spirit gives birth to Spirit.
sentences.zh: 血肉产生血肉，灵性产生灵性。

sentences.en: They were pleased at the birth of their first child.
sentences.zh: 他们很高兴迎来了第一个孩子。

senses.zh: 出生，诞生；出身，血统；起源，开端
